page.notes: Printed "s" long s rendered as s throughout; ct ligature in "mactat" rendered as ct. Page number and running head are printed at the top. The catchword "ditio" stands at lower right below the last line. Italic extent for "Sicut dicitur," and "Prophetæ." is roman in the print. The reference "1.Co.11.27" is printed with a comma after 11 and rendered here with a stop. Minor doubtful points: whether "Præterea" is wholly italic and the exact form of the Mat.26.28. reference.
